items.title: Lawrence Duhé Interview, 1957-06-09
items.q: Red Sydney, you remember Sydney? Yeah, yeah. We used to laugh at Sydney.

ctx.x: I mean, there was a hide there.

I remember Piron, I saw that job. Piron, yeah. Red Sydney, you remember Sydney? Yeah, yeah. We used to laugh at Sydney. He used to cut off. He used to cut off. Remember we used to laugh at him? Yeah, I remember.
Any other bands in New Orleans that you played with that you can remember?
